subject: Request: Split invoice cadence + limited strategic discount for 2027 pilot
messages:
From: Sana Malik <sana.malik@keplerhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@keplerhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot billing ask + modest discount for 2027 pilot

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Kepler is excited about Redwood's latency and the billing visibility. Procurement asked me to surface one quick commercial request while legal finishes the SOW: would Redwood consider a split-invoice cadence for the 2027 pilot? Specifically: two invoice milestones (50% at kick-off, 50% at completion of pilot) on a quarterly invoicing cadence (invoices issued on the 1st of quarter months) instead of standard monthly billing.

Because this is a pilot tied to a larger enterprise buy in H2 2027, Procurement is also asking if you can provide a small, limited discount (10%) for the pilot term only (3 months). They emphasized this needs exec consent and that it would be documented in the SOW.

I've attached the redlined SOW from our side and a proposed payment tracker for your team to review. Can you let me know if this is something you can route for approval? If so, please advise what level of executive sign-off is required and any conditions Redwood would need (e.g., deposit, PO, usage caps).

Thanks,
Sana Malik
Senior Procurement Manager
Kepler Health

Attachments: Kepler_SOW_v2.pdf, kepler_payment_schedule.xlsx
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Malik <sana.malik@keplerhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot billing ask + modest discount for 2027 pilot

Hi Sana — really appreciate the clear ask and the SOW.

Short answer: we can consider a temporary split/quarterly invoice cadence for a short pilot, but I need to route a conditional approval through Deal Desk + my manager. A few immediate asks from our side so we can present a concrete recommendation to our finance team:
- Can Kepler commit to a PO or prepay deposit for the first 50% milestone?
- Confirm expected usage band for the pilot (tokens/day or average concurrent requests) — that helps us size buffers.
- Is the 10% discount request limited strictly to the pilot months (3 months) with standard list pricing after?

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot billing ask + modest discount for 2027 pilot — request for exec approval

Marissa — forwarding Kepler's ask. Summary / recommended disposition from Deal Desk: we can approve a temporary split invoice cadence for a timeboxed pilot with the following conditions:

1) Approve quarterly issuance for pilot only (two invoices total, 50%/50%).
2) Approve a capped limited discount of 7% (instead of 10%) for the pilot term only; discount expires at end of pilot and does not apply to subsequent committed spend.
3) Require a 25% prepay at contract signature (applies to first milestone), remainder invoiced per agreed milestone.
4) Include an explicit usage cap in the SOW and a monthly alert if projected usage exceeds 125% of band. Any overage billed at list rates.
5) Legal to sign off on redline to ensure no lingering license/indemnity exposure.

Rationale: Kepler is strategic in our healthcare vertical and likely to expand; they asked for 10% but Deal Desk recommends 7% for a short pilot to protect margin while demonstrating outcome. This is an exception to standard billing and should be escalated to Marissa for exec sign-off (manager-level) before I confirm to procurement.

I attached a draft approval memo and the revised payment schedule showing the 7% discount and proposed prepay.

—Karthik
Deal Desk, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the summary, Karthik. I agree with a timeboxed exception but would like the following baked into our approval before we communicate back to Kepler:

- Approve the 7% pilot discount conditional on (a) 25% prepay at signature and (b) a usage cap with automatic notification and pause clause if usage is >150% of cap.
- Approval limited to the pilot (three months) with an explicit re-price conversation at pilot close — no carry-forward of discount.
- Legal to complete the SOW redline and confirm indemnities are unchanged; commercial team to send final approved SOW to Procurement with a version note.

Please update the cover note to Kepler (Ive drafted language below) and I will sign off. Once legal confirms, Karthik you have my green light to finalize pricing in HubSpot and instruct finance on the invoice cadence.

Proposed message to Kepler: "We can accommodate a split invoicing cadence for a timeboxed pilot and approve a 7% pilot discount provided Redwood receives a 25% prepayment at signature and the SOW includes a defined usage cap. The discount applies only to the pilot term; standard pricing resumes afterward. Legal will finalize the SOW redlines and we will issue invoices per the agreed milestone schedule."

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
